regulatory_history.title: In the Matter of Gravy Analytics, Inc. and Venntel, Inc. (FTC Docket No. C-4810)
regulatory_history.notes: Proposed 2024-12-03 and final 2025-01-13 (announced 2025-01-14, approved 5-0). It bars Gravy Analytics and Venntel from selling, disclosing or using sensitive location data except in limited national security and law enforcement cases, and requires a sensitive location data program. The order runs 20 years. No admission of the charges.
